Emma is a pet lover. She believes there are a lot of health benefits of keeping a pet. For example, it
has been proven that pets have a positive effect on our mood. Her grandmother is a real example. She
used to be really sad when her grandfather suddenly passed away. In order to help her get through sadness,
Emma bought her a pet dog. Taking care of the dog gives her grandmother a new purpose in her life. And
the dog also helps her forget her depression and loneliness. With the faithful company of the dog, her
grandmother becomes much happier. She’s now 85 years old and she’s very healthy. Emma thinks it’s the
best decision she has ever made to buy her grandmother a pet dog.
